name: 李俊賢
objective: Teaching Topics: Discrete-time systems and the z-transform, sampling and reconstruction, open-loop discrete-time systems, closed-loop systems, system time-response characteristics, stability analysis techniques, and digital controller design
schedule:
Week 1-2: Introduction
Week 3-4: Discrete-time systems and the z-transform
Week 5-6: Sampling and reconstruction
Week 7-8: Open-loop discrete-time systems
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10-11: Closed-loop systems
Week 12-13: System time-response characteristics
Week 14-15: Stability analysis techniques/Digital controller design
Week 16: Final Exam
scorePolicy: Labs: 30%, Quizzes: 10%, Midterm: 20%, Final: 20%, Participation: 10%, Study Reports: 10%
materials: Textbook: C. L. Phillips, H. T. Nagle, and A. Chakrabortty, Digital Control Systems: Analysis & Design, Pearson Education (滄海圖書代理).
consultation: 請 email 至授課教師洽詢課程相關資訊。
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
